notes.title: Campido - Update - Version 1.5
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.pngA Massive change in terms of graphics and user experience.
- Menu Effects / Animation
- Game UI Effects / Animation
- Card Animation

https://i.giphy.com/media/lOIvyyDGDn8EvoL4UQ/giphy.webp

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.pngNew Classic Mode
-Play the classic version of Campido (Stage 5) straight away without progressing through the campaign.

https://i.giphy.com/media/cKthLCgfuzQaV1QHJc/giphy.webp

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.pngNew Skins
-Play as the cat or the husky, dress as an exotic merchant from the orient.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/427c6cbdacdecce5bccef7da5836aecc204f9d57.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/4b2bc7284ade9024db17990489e9138bbcfd1522.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.pngNew Music
-You may now enjoy 5 new additional tracks which may shuffle along each match by random.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.pngBug Fixes
- Coins Multiplier changed to 2 (From 0), 
- Boogaloo card may replace only some of the cards.
- Match freezing in some rare cases.
- A sporadic issue in which cards are not being "Disposed" when discarded.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.pngMisc
- The game was unpublished from Google Play Store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.pngAn Apology
Fixing some of the things in Campido took some time (a whole lot of time).
These delays & Lack of response to feedback is something a customer should not endure.
These issues will hopefully not reoccur in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.pngFeedback
-Please share your thoughts, suggestions, issues with the game. Each and every response/review is more than helpful and highly appreciated.

Have fun!
